card.name: Injection after radiopharmaceutical names, and 'of' in named places
card.fires_on: The word Injection right after a radiopharmaceutical name (e.g., Ga 68 DOTATOC, Thallous Chloride Tl 201). Also 'of' inside proper names of places or events, like Port of Miami or Siege of Acre.

modes.label: Radiopharmaceutical Injection
modes.description: The word Injection following a radioactive drug name with isotope and number.
modes.example: Use waterproof gloves, effective radiation shielding and appropriate safety measures when preparing and handling Ga 68 DOTATOC<< Injection>>.

modes.label: 'of' in proper names
modes.description: The word 'of' after a noun like Port, Battle, Siege or Academy in a named place or event.
modes.example: He applied twice unsuccessfully for admission to the Vienna Academy<< of>> Fine Arts.
